integrity: Analytical spectral-Gram proof, independently corroborated by the complete standalone numerical test script. The tests sample finite sizes and do not imply an infinite proof. No external or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns p,q >= 3, positive adjacency hopping, positive loss at every coincidence site and eventual capture. No finite-time uniformity, disorder, correlated noise, nonrectangular loss pattern, or symmetrization is asserted.
title: Velocity resonance and exact collision absorption on complete bipartite quantum networks
